summary: Hiker fell and slid nearly 100 ft down a rock face at the top of Greyrock Trail; helicopter dropped in rescue personnel, patient had minor injuries and walked out
responding_agency: Larimer County SAR + Larimer County Sheriff Emergency Services, UCHealth Special Operations Rescue Team, LifeLine helicopter
notes: One of three simultaneous Larimer County missions that day; reached trailhead ~9:50pm
